_doc: Starting values for export. Drawing conveniences only, not design rules. paper: sheet sizes in millimetres, short side first. scales / siteScales: the scales offered for storey plans and for the site plan (100 = 1:100). marginMm: blank edge of a PDF sheet. titleBlockMm: height of the title strip at the bottom of a sheet. textHeightMm: height of lettering on paper; in a DXF the lettering is sized so that it has this height when plotted at the chosen scale. lineWeightMm: line weight on paper per layer. layers: the DXF layer name and AutoCAD colour index (1 red, 2 yellow, 3 green, 4 cyan, 5 blue, 6 magenta, 7 black/white, 8 grey) of each kind of line. dxfGap: distance in metres between drawings laid side by side in one DXF file.
